what: `research/queue/README.md` documents `blocked` as a supported status, but the dispatcher's validator requires `run.workflow` and `lands.store` REGARDLESS of status — and a blocked job is blocked precisely because those do not exist yet. So the documented status is unrepresentable, and any attempt to use it grades `invalid` on every dispatcher run.
